name: Omarchy Spotify
author: QuickshellSpotify
description: Spotify in Quickshell with all the features you need—using about 60 MB of memory versus roughly 950 MB for the official client.

barWidget.description: Spotify in Quickshell with all the features you need—using about 60 MB of memory versus roughly 950 MB for the official client.

schema.label: This computer appears as
schema.description: Shown in Devices immediately. Spotify Connect uses the new name the next time local playback starts.

schema.label: Sleep empty local receiver
schema.description: Minutes after the player closes when no media is loaded. Paused media stays available to resume. Use 0 to keep this computer available even while the player is closed.

schema.label: Open mini-player from bar
schema.description: When off, clicking the Spotify bar icon opens the full player directly.

schema.label: Spinning vinyl artwork
schema.description: Adds a spinning vinyl record for the mini-player artwork while music is playing.

schema.label: Keyboard shortcut opens
schema.description: Choose whether Super+Shift+M launches Omarchy's Music app, the full player, or the mini-player. Requires the one-time bindings.lua override from the README; without it Omarchy's stock Music binding stays active.

schema.label: Shortcut hints
schema.description: After the first shortcut, matching controls show the next key to press. Shortcuts still work when this is off.

schema.label: Lyrics button
schema.description: Show the Omasing lyrics button in the player and mini-player. When off, Ctrl+Shift+L is inactive too.

schema.label: Show track title in bar
schema.description: Show the current song title in the bar.

schema.label: Show artist name in bar
schema.description: Show the current artist name in the bar.

schema.label: Show paused track in bar
schema.description: When off, the bar returns to the Spotify icon while playback is paused. The session remains available to resume.

schema.label: Bar text scroll speed
schema.description: Multiplier from 0.25 to 3.00. The default speed is 1.

schema.label: Maximum bar text width
schema.description: Width from 160 to 560 px. Use 0 for unlimited.

schema.label: Fixed bar width
schema.description: When on, the bar label always reserves the maximum width while a track is shown, so neighbouring widgets do not shift between songs. Unavailable while the width is unlimited.

schema.label: Local playback quality
schema.description: Takes effect the next time playback starts.

schema.label: Local playback output
schema.description: PulseAudio sink that local playback opens. Empty follows the system default. Choose it from the player's Settings; it takes effect the next time playback starts.

schema.label: Spotify Developer app client ID
schema.description: Optional personal Spotify Developer app client ID, with its own quota. Empty keeps the plugin's client. A valid 32-hex ID is required. Changing it clears the current session and requires authorization for your app.
